analysis: Examined base_text units for ClusterOnboardingLive.swift lines 912-1725 (model listing, approval checks, provisioning via peer copy/catalog download, adopt, register, serve, scope, test settlement). The base changed ranges in these units are 1450, 1505, 1509 and 1681 (localRegister guard, serve(), localServe). The head counterparts (1459-1462, 1517-1527, 1699-1702) are outside these base-only units. The visible patch shows serve gaining unlessStoppedSince/stopsBefore and status replies gaining stopsAsked: a stop-generation fence that keeps a serve from overriding a stop a person asked for after it. This looks like an availability/ordering control on the paired cluster link (A-018), not an authorization, attestation or encryption change. No changed lines here touch artifact verification (ClusterModelCopyTrust.servableArtifacts, manifest SHA-256 checks at 1197-1202, 1247-1250), coordinator approval (ClusterApprovalSync.decision at 1454), or the prefix-cache paths covered by T-041. No regression is identified in the visible base evidence. Integration should check four things in head source: (1) the localServe(unlessStoppedSince:) comparison is not inverted, so a stale serve cannot restart parts after a stop, and a peer-supplied stopsBefore nil defaults safely; (2) the localRegister change at head 1459-1462 still returns without registering on a local-only scope or a failed approval decision, and still re-serves only after drain; (3) stopsAsked counters come from the authenticated paired link (ClusterSetupLinkExchange) rather than an unauthenticated source; (4) the head execute/followerStatus change around 399-408 introduces no new exposure.
